heroHeadline: Ukraine Launches Largest-Ever Drone Attack on Moscow — ~556 Drones; 4 Killed in Russia; Sheremetyevo Airport Paralyzed; 234 Front-Line Engagements on Day 1,543
heroSubtitle: Overnight into May 17, 2026, Ukraine launched its largest drone attack of the entire war — approximately 556 drones targeting Moscow's oil refinery, Transneft pumping stations, and the ELMA Technopark, while debris struck Sheremetyevo Airport causing ~200 flight cancellations. At least 4 people were killed in Russia (3 in Moscow region, 1 in Belgorod) and 12 wounded. Ukraine's SBU confirmed the joint Armed Forces operation targeting military-industrial and fuel infrastructure. Zelensky called it 'entirely justified — a completely fair response' to Russia's killing of 24 Ukrainian civilians in recent Kyiv strikes. Simultaneously, Russia launched 287 drones at Ukraine overnight (279 intercepted), injuring 9 in Dnipropetrovsk and Zaporizhzhia. On the front lines, 234 combat engagements were recorded — Pokrovsk sector saw the highest Russian activity — while Ukrainian forces advanced in the Hulyaipole direction and repelled 7 Russian assaults at the Kursk/Sumy axis. Russian cumulative military losses reached an estimated 1,348,790 (+1,170 in 24 hours). The dual escalation on Day 1,543 marks a new phase: both capitals now face drone strikes, and Ukraine's deep-strike campaign has reached unprecedented scale.
